description: The networks Gloam runs on, mainnets first, with each vault (pool) address, each mainnet's private swap router, the assets you can deposit (on mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0 and OUSD on Tempo, USDG and GLOAM on Robinhood Chain; on testnet: OUSD and PathUSD on Tempo, USDG and ETH on Robinhood Chain), explorers, RPCs and the testnet faucets.

network.description: Gloam network: "robinhood-mainnet" (Robinhood Chain mainnet: USDG and GLOAM), "tempo-mainnet" (Tempo mainnet: USDC.e, pathUSD, USDT0, OUSD), or a testnet: "tempo" (Tempo Moderato), "robinhood" (Robinhood Chain testnet) or "base" (Base Sepolia). Leave out for every network.
